## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:identity` · `pm:blocked`. The exported default pages make the same sign-up decision as the console, through one shared function

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-06T07:58Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `@object-ui/app-shell`'s exported `DefaultLoginPage` and `DefaultRegisterPage` ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: they read `disableSignUp` alone, where the server states the rule in two keys (objectui#11691). Their named producer is `examples/console-starter/src/App.tsx`.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#11691

- **Why p2:** the same defect as objectui#11691, on a published surface. Every starter built from the example offers a sign-up form the server refuses under the default posture.
- **Direction:**
  - The default pages call the decision objectui#11691's PR introduces (`decideSignUpOffer`, including the first-owner window ruled on that card). Move it to a module both can import, rather than copying it.
  - ⛔ No second copy of the rule.
- **Why blocked:** the shared decision lands with PR objectui#11703, and this card reuses it.
- **Pins:** under `invite_only` with an owner, the default login page shows no generic "Sign up"; an invitation redirect and a no-owner deployment still show it; `disableSignUp: true` hides everything.

## ACCEPT: PR objectui#11711 at `54cb036` (`Fixes #11705`). The at-tier contract review is owed before enqueue

`domain:ui` execution seat 2 · `session_01FngvPpdrnhHMdHHq6vwwju` (`os-justin`) · 2026-10-06T10:48Z. Dev report: `os-dev-report` on this card.

- **Shape:** draft, base `main` at `da35453`, first line `Fixes #11705`, and the body has no other closing keyword. `Clause-②: yes` is at the start of a line. 14 files, +739/−184. No governed path, no `content/docs/releases/` edit.
- **File surface amended:** `packages/auth/src/types.ts` is added to the claim's surface. The edit is comment-only: the `audiencePosture` doc comment ships in `@object-ui/auth`'s `dist/types.d.ts` and named `apps/console/src/pages/auth/signUpOffer.ts`, which this PR deletes. The seat accepts the fix in place, per os-dev's rule that published text a round makes false is corrected in that round.
- **Seat's own reading of the diff:**
  - `decideSignUpOffer`, `needsBootstrapProbe`, `isInvitationRedirect`, `audienceAdmitsUninvitedSignUp` move from `apps/console/src/pages/auth/signUpOffer.ts` to `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/signUpOffer.ts` (a git rename). `useBootstrapStatus` / `BootstrapStatus` move from `setupEntry.ts` to `./bootstrapStatus.ts`. Both bodies are unchanged apart from comments and imports. The console copy is deleted with no shim, and the console pages and `/setup` entry import from `@object-ui/app-shell`. That is one decision with no second copy, as the card and triage direct.
  - `DefaultLoginPage` hands `LoginForm` a `registerUrl` only on `form`, carrying `?redirect=`. `DefaultRegisterPage` bounces `closed` to `/login` (keeping `?redirect=`), renders nothing on `pending`, and on `by-invitation` renders `auth.register.errors.selfRegistrationClosed` before any form.
  - The entry gains the decision, the probe and their three types. No export is removed and no type changes, so `Clause-②: yes`. The arm is widening, as the changeset states. `audienceAdmitsUninvitedSignUp` ships in `dist/` and stays off the entry.
- **Done-when, checked against the pins:** `defaultPagesFollowPosture-11705.test.tsx` renders the shipped pages over a real `AuthProvider` / `createAuthClient` with only `fetch` stubbed. Six login cases and five register cases cover:
  - `invite_only` with an owner: no link, and an explanation instead of the form;
  - an invitation redirect: the link, then a sign-up request on the wire;
  - no owner: the link and the form;
  - `open` / `email_domain`: unchanged, with no probe;
  - no posture: `disableSignUp` alone decides;
  - `disableSignUp: true`: everything is hidden, and an invitation redirect is bounced.

  objectui#11691's five decision cases moved byte-identical, and its eleven page pins stayed byte-identical (dev's compare).
- **Changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell`: `minor`), checked sentence by sentence against the diff:**
  - the behaviour paragraph matches the two pages;
  - the Clause-② paragraph lists exactly the seven entry names in `index.ts`;
  - the not-published sentence matches the entry.
- **Tests and gates (dev, measured):**
  - app-shell: the 16 new cases, the auth directory (30), and the 17 barrel or touched-module files (91) are green.
  - console: `pages/auth/` + `SetupRoute.test.tsx` (82) is green.
  - Three type-checks, three lints and 22 root gates exit 0.
  - One reverse-verification leg turned 7 of 11 red, as predicted, and was restored by blob.
  - Eager closure: +77 B gzip, 7.0 KB headroom left.
  - Declared: the full 1029-file app-shell suite was not run locally and is left to CI.
- **Seat's observation, Acceptance note, not blocking:** `DefaultRegisterPage` gates its probe on `!user`, as the console page does. A visitor who is already signed in and opens `/register` under `invite_only` therefore stays on `pending` and sees an empty layout. Before this PR that visitor got the form. The console page redirects a signed-in visitor away, so this only reaches the default page, and only for a signed-in visit to `/register`.
- **Out-of-scope findings (2), Acceptance notes, none filed:**
  - the default pages still `navigate('/')` after success and ignore `?redirect=` (no in-repo producer mounts both with `/accept-invitation`);
  - `SetupPage`'s own duplicate `bootstrap-status` fetch (pre-existing, static read).
- **PR body:** the seat amends the "Verification" heading to name both heads (`f133f3c` differs from `54cb036` only by `packages/app-shell/README.md`), per the dev's report.
- **Owed before enqueue:** the at-tier contract review, and CI green on `54cb036`. `needs:contract-review` is hung on the PR in this stroke.
